newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez Lyonnaise to decide GTM fate in two years.
newsitem.headline: Suez Lyonnaise to decide GTM fate in two years.

text.p: Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux, the entity created by the proposed merger of Suez and Lyonnaise des Eaux, has two years to decide the fate of its construction unit GTM-Entrepose, Jerome Monod, the chairman of Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Monday.

"The situation today is that the public works and construction sector has been restructured and rehabilitated and this will be even more the case in 1997 and 1998," Monod told a meeting of financial analysts.
"At that time we will be able to calmly take the strategic decisions necessary, and under good conditions," he said.
Lyonnaise des Eaux controls 50 percent of GTM Entrepose, which in turn controls construction units Dumez-GTM and Entreprise Jean Lefebvre and has a significant stake in Cofiroute.
